chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

Regarding a deer that a man hunted, and the people began cutting it up while the one who hunted it was preventing them, so it was said that there was a prohibition in it; he said: “There is no prohibition in it, and there is no harm in it.”
ai.seo_question: Is there any prohibition or problem if people cut up a deer hunted by someone else while he tries to stop them?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a hunted deer over which others began cutting it while the hunter objected. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no prohibition in this matter and no harm in it, indicating permissibility.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4140 - Imam (as) said regarding a deer that a man hunted, and people started cutting it up while the one who hunted it was trying to prevent them.
Imam (as) said: "There is no prohibition in it, and there is no harm in it."
